x: Ten more I.C.C.U. appearances went by until at Sheffield in 1962, team-mate Roelants became the 3rd man to push the unfortunate Vandewattyne into 2nd position.
World record holder Ron Clarke did not appear but there was still Roelants and Poileunis of Belgium and Sawaki and Suzuki of Japan to chivvy up our runners.

Performances from Hines, Carlos, Evans and company confirmed the former and our fears over the altitude question were supported not only by abysmal British performances but also by below par efforts by 'greats' such as Ryun, Roelants and Haase.
